companyFieldUpdates.description: Renewa LLC acquires land, lease interests, rental streams and royalties beneath operating and planned U.S. renewable-energy and power infrastructure, providing long-term site-control capital to landowners, developers, project owners, operators and independent power producers. EnCap founded the predecessor Paloma Solar & Wind in May 2021 and sold it to QIC-managed client capital in 2022; the platform adopted the Renewa name on September 20, 2022. La Caisse invested US$200 million of primary equity on July 15, 2025 through its Sustainable Land Management initiative. Renewa reported more than 160 facilities, more than 85 developers and over US$1.25 billion of capital commitments after a January 2026 financing. QIC manages a current ownership interest for undisclosed client or fund capital, and La Caisse is a current direct-equity owner; their percentages and exact legal vehicles are not publicly disclosed. Parcels, leases, financing SPVs and underlying projects remain assets rather than separate PortCos. No later platform sale, exit or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 23, 2026.
